title: 1957 New addition to HHS, gymnasium with stage, changing rooms, laboratory, admin offices, and classrooms
description: Hartland High School unveiled its new $100,000 addition on the right side of the building, first opened to the public during the graduation exercises on Thursday night in 1959. This expansion included a large auditorium and six new classrooms. In 1958, eight additional classrooms were created in the older section by removing the old auditorium and using the basement space.
